title: Only 8% Pass This Human Anatomy Quiz
summary: Ten questions spanning organs, bones and the body systems that keep everything working.

landing.intro:
10 questions. One anatomy challenge.
How well do you know your body?

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment quiz tests general knowledge of the human body, from major organs and bones to circulation and breathing. Every question has one clear answer drawn from widely accepted introductory anatomy.

Choose one answer for each question. See your score at the end, then unlock the correct answers to any questions you missed and a breakdown of your results by topic.

Anatomical details can vary naturally between individuals. The quiz uses the standard adult anatomy conventions commonly taught in general education.

steps: Answer ten human anatomy questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one of four answers for every question.
Reveal your final score, then unlock a review of any incorrect answers.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not medical advice, training or a clinical assessment.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your anatomy score is ready. You can then unlock a closer look at your results.

profile-1.title: The Anatomy Expert
profile-1.copy: From tiny bones to major organs, your knowledge of the human body is exceptional. Very little in this challenge caught you out.

profile-2.title: The Body Scholar
profile-2.copy: You cleared the 8/10 pass mark with an impressive command of anatomy. The body’s structures and systems are clearly familiar territory.

profile-3.title: The Sharp Student
profile-3.copy: You answered 6 or 7 questions correctly. Unlock the answer review to see which details you missed and build on what you know.

profile-4.title: The Curious Learner
profile-4.copy: You answered 4 or 5 questions correctly. Unlock the answer review to discover the facts behind the questions you missed.

profile-5.title: The New Explorer
profile-5.copy: Human anatomy has plenty of surprises. Unlock the answer review to explore the questions you missed and pick up a few facts for next time.
